StrmTool.PluginDescription: Extracts technical media information (codec, resolution, subtitles) from strm files to enhance library display and playback performance.
StrmTool.TaskDescription: Extracts technical media information (codec, resolution, subtitles) from strm files.
StrmTool.Subtitle: Extract audio, video codec, resolution, and subtitle streams from strm files to enhance media library display and instant playback performance
StrmTool.DescForceRefreshWarning: Force refresh significantly increases remote probing requests and may trigger rate limits on third-party cloud drives or WebDAV. Only enable during maintenance or troubleshooting.
StrmTool.LblEnableAutoExtract: Automatically extract media info for new strm files
StrmTool.DescEnableAutoExtract: When enabled, newly added strm files will automatically extract media info in the background without manual task execution
StrmTool.DescEnableMediaInfoCache: Extracted media info will be cached as .strmtool.json alongside the file, enabling instant reuse and minimizing remote probing
StrmTool.DescRefreshDelay: Milliseconds to wait after each media info refresh to smooth traffic and prevent overwhelming remote servers
StrmTool.ResetSuccess: Restored default settings. Click Save to apply.
StrmTool.DescMaxConcurrentExtract: Maximum number of concurrent background media extraction tasks (server restart required to apply)
StrmTool.DescForceRefreshIgnoreExisting: Execute refresh even if media stream information already exists in Jellyfin (local cache can still be used)
StrmTool.LblForceRefreshIgnoreCache: Ignore cache and force remote probe
StrmTool.DescForceRefreshIgnoreCache: Bypass .strmtool.json cache files and probe remote stream info directly via network
StrmTool.DescMetadataRestoreTimeout: Maximum time to wait for metadata restoration when strm file size is reset (1-30 minutes)
